_doc: Single source of truth for the drift-prone currency literals shared across the relay's fake_catalog() (crates/dpay-relay/src/ledger.rs) and the app's BUNDLED_CATALOG (app/config/catalog.ts). Cross-checked by: (1) a Rust #[cfg(test)] drift-alarm in ledger.rs, (2) a jest drift-alarm in app/__tests__/catalog.test.ts. A drift in either direction goes RED. The relay's live /catalog response remains the RUNTIME source of truth; this file + the two fallbacks are COLD-START FALLBACKS only. Does NOT cover the staging deploy script (scripts/dfx-deploy-ic-staging.sh), whose testnet catalog uses genuinely different principals/contracts (Sepolia). The decimals.eth entry pins the precision-extreme 18-dec fixture that lives only in fake_catalog (no ETH in BUNDLED_CATALOG) — the jest side does not assert it.
